summary: This dataset involves the study of mustard gas (MG) toxicity in the conjunctiva, a region of the eye, using in vitro and in vivo models. The study aims to investigate the mechanisms underlying MG-induced ocular damage and the potential of specialized pro-resolving mediators (SPMs), such as D-series resolvins RvD1, to restore homeostasis and prevent chronic damage. The study will evaluate conjunctival and corneal damage, as well as ocular surface innervation, in a mouse model of MG toxicity.
